description: Many tokens' supply pressure in one call: items (up to 300 of {symbol} or {contract, chain}), or gem_screener=true for every Gem Screener coin. Each row: status, pressure and its range, yearly_pct, band, the seven slices of today's pie, pile_24m (the sellable pile over the next 24 months), next_unlock, dilution_week_pct, unknown_names, refreshed_at. From EventTrader's Supply Analyzer (cymetica.com/supply-analyzer). Every input carries its value, unit, source and date; unknown inputs are named, never zero. A measure of the token's supply, not a forecast of its price. Read-only, no key. Not financial advice.
